PythonFullStrategy:
Query geometric properties of the most recently rendered diagram.

            Args:
                query_type: One of "list_objects", "coordinate", "distance",
                    "angle", "length", "radius", "area", "perimeter".
                params: Query arguments — call list_objects first to see valid IDs.
                    "length" takes a segment or an arc/sector (its curved edge);
                    "radius" a circle, arc or sector (an ellipse or elliptical
                    arc/sector returns hradius and vradius); "area" a polygon,
                    circle, ellipse or sector (an open arc has none); "perimeter"
                    a polygon, circle, ellipse or sector (two radii plus the arc).
            Returns:
                JSON with query result or error.
eval:
Query a geometric property of the current diagram.

                query_type and params:
                  coordinate  {"id": "A"}              -> x, y coords
                  distance    {"id1": "A", "id2": "B"} -> distance between points
                  angle       {"ray1": "A", "vertex": "B", "ray2": "C"} -> angle in degrees
                  length      {"id": "seg_AB"}          -> segment length, or an arc/sector's curved edge
                  radius      {"id": "c1"}              -> circle/arc/sector radius (ellipse: hradius, vradius)
                  area        {"id": "tri_ABC"}         -> polygon, circle, ellipse or sector area
                  perimeter   {"id": "tri_ABC"}         -> polygon, circle/ellipse or sector perimeter
                  list_objects {}                       -> all objects and their types
